subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge + Acme Retail - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudbridge.io>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge + Acme Retail - recap & next steps

Hi Alex & Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of needs (Acme Retail):
- Ingest customer chat logs and product catalog to generate personalized product recommendations across web and mobile.
- Low-latency inference for checkout experiences (target p95 < 200ms).
- Data residency questions for EU customers (future phase).

What we heard from CloudBridge:
- CloudBridge will handle vendor onboarding and provide the marketplace integration for billing and provisioning.
- Partner SE can join the technical deep dive to walk Acme through connector architecture and auth flow.

Proposed next step: Partner-led technical deep dive / joint demo (60 min) to align on integration pattern, auth, and performance targets. External attendees: Acme Eng + Product, CloudBridge SE, Redwood SE.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Mar 4, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu Mar 5, 2:00–3:00pm PT

Alex — can you confirm availability for your SE and which slot works best? Sofia — do either of these times work for your team?

I'm attaching a draft agenda and draft list of data samples we'd like to review. Also happy to adjust timing.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (18KB)]

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
